name: The Lodge at Torrey Pines
insider_take: This Craftsman-style gem sits majestically above the legendary Torrey Pines Golf Course, where PGA Tour pros battle it out annually just steps from your room.
whats_special: The Lodge is built entirely from rare materials like Douglas fir and features authentic Mission-style architecture. You're staying adjacent to one of only two natural habitats in the world where the ancient Torrey Pine tree grows wild—some specimens are over 100 years old. The hotel overlooks the Pacific where gray whales migrate seasonally, and Torrey Pines State Beach below is a renowned surfing spot that's been featured in countless films.
pro_tip: Book a cliffside room during whale migration season (December-April) for front-row seats to one of nature's greatest spectacles, and time your stay during the Farmers Insurance Open to watch PGA Tour action from your balcony.
dont_miss: The sunrise hike through Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve—it's a 2,000-acre wilderness preserve with trails leading to hidden beaches and dramatic cliff overlooks. The reserve protects the rarest pine tree in America, and the biodiversity here rivals any national park.
pros: Prime location overlooking Torrey Pines Golf Course
Award-winning A.R. Valentien restaurant featuring farm-to-table cuisine
Craftsman-style architecture with elegant coastal design
Close proximity to La Jolla beaches and Torrey Pines State Reserve
Full-service spa and exceptional personalized service
